name: sms-tools
description: External SMS consumer: exposes the sms@1 capability as the tools 'sms_numbers', 'sms_list', 'sms_get' and 'sms_code' - provider agnostic, no backend named

config.description: The consumer only shapes the tools it registers; the numbers themselves belong to the provider's row.

maxListLimit.description: Cap of the 'limit' the 'sms_list' tool accepts (default 50, never above the contract's 100).

includeBodies.description: When false the 'sms_list' tool reports message metadata without the bodies (default true).
